_comment: Known public elevation-tile services: URL substrings that pin an XYZ
layer to an elevation encoding and/or to the deepest zoom the service
(_known_services); the matching logic lives there, only the data lives
here. Every entry needs a non-empty 'match' (substring, compared
lower-case against the decoded tile URL template); 'encoding' must be
'terrarium' or 'mapbox' when present; 'max_zoom' an integer when
present. Order matters for max_zoom: the first matching entry wins.
